mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced labor market friction enhances corporate profitability and consumer spending.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not cross below 5.0% within the forecast horizon, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than a baseline period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate expanding demand, which amplifies corporate earnings growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in tandem over the forecast horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% during a tightening cycle elevates borrowing costs, dampening equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate does not exceed 2.0% or show upward momentum within the forecast horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 5% or higher quarterly GDP growth in the prior quarter during a post-shock recovery period signals resilient economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Quarterly GDP growth does not exceed 5% in the prior quarter, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward trajectory in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding supply chains and reduced production bottlenecks, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The industrial production index does not show upward momentum over the forecast horizon, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) simultaneously signal a robust labor market, which enhances corporate productivity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in tandem over the forecast horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in the federal funds rate and the CPI inflation index signal accelerating inflationary pressures, which erode equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in tandem over the forecast horizon, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
